Overview
This 6-week program is designed for bouldering
specialists with some experience training structured
power endurance that would like to improve their
fitness on longer boulder problems. The template is
designed to be split across three training days per
week. The first training day should consist of a warm-
up, followed by project bouldering using the Style
Triad workout, and then either 6 in 6 (Weeks 1-2) or
Boulder Triples (Weeks 4-5) to complete the session.
The second training day will consist of a warm-up,
followed by Linked Boulders (except on Weeks 3 & 6).
A third training day should consist of either the Finger
Strength Testing Session (Week 1) or the 7:3s 70-80%
